aggregation.bootstrap_quantiles: numpy.quantile with method=linear over five aggregate replicate values
aggregation.routing_macro: equal mean of per-domain accuracies after equal-seed aggregation
aggregation.segmentation: pool pixel confusion within each seed/domain/policy, derive metrics, then average seeds and domains equally

order: capture initial backend state before pinned JASCL import
import pinned JASCL classifier without constructing a model, reading a checkpoint, forwarding, or intentionally initializing CUDA
apply the registered deterministic backend configuration immediately
verify the registered state after every descriptor and expert phase

bootstrap.draw: For replicate 0..4, within each seed/stage/domain resample N selected memory rows with replacement using numpy PCG64 and S([pres-dsr-sf-v0.2-bootstrap,seed,stage,domain,replicate]); retain formal case-hash folds and use draw multiplicities as weights.
bootstrap.refit: Repeat lambda selection, temperature selection, and closed-form ridge fitting from resampled train memory; evaluate cached validation descriptors and expert probabilities.

call_graph.compile_after: exact execution source commit and tests are pushed and remote-verified

controls.C1_ORACLE: fixed true-domain-to-snapshot mapping; never validation-best selection
controls.C2_M1_HARD: clean recomputation of the V0.1 normalized-block M1 cosine router
controls.C3_M2_HARD: clean recomputation of the V0.1 normalized-block M2 cosine router
controls.C4_M1_SOFT: softmax over clean M1 cosine scores with temperature selected on train_unlabeled-only five-fold logits
controls.C5_RIDGE_HARD: argmax of the selected ridge probabilities; exact ties choose the lowest domain index
controls.C7_UNIFORM: uniform probability ensemble over seen experts; descriptive only
controls.rescue_rule: No control can rescue C6 or change E4.

data_roles.validation_domain_id: routing evaluator only after router output seal
data_roles.validation_GT: segmentation evaluator only after descriptor, router, lambda/temperature, expert-probability, and mixture seals

descriptor.formula_per_block: spatial channel mean concatenated with log(spatial population std + 1e-6)
descriptor.forward: stage0 REFUGE best EMA encoder per seed; eval, no_grad, AMP off, float32
descriptor.standardization: fit global per-dimension mean/std on seen-domain train memory only; std<=1e-12 maps to zero and is recorded constant; validation uses frozen statistics

expert_bank.preprocessing_and_postprocessing: exact frozen regenerated-B0 evaluator; no per-domain postprocessing

hard_stop: After the validation report commit and publication receipt are pushed and remote-verified, stop for independent review.
input_scope: Only the complete frozen Gate1C regenerated-B0 bundle, exact nine B0 stage-best checkpoints, and public PRES V0.1 diagnostic status; V0.1 raw metric rows are not V0.2 evidence.

memory.cap_selection: sort by case_hash then case_id and keep the first 512 when a domain exceeds 512 rows

ridge_router.closed_form: solve(X^T A X + lambda*R, X^T A Y) on CPU float64; X includes a constant bias column and R has zero at the bias coordinate
ridge_router.domain_weight: within each fit, every seen domain has total mass 1/number_of_seen_domains
ridge_router.folds: Within each seed/stage/domain, sort unique cases by sha256(UTF8(pres-dsr-sf-v0.2-fold\0 + case_id)) then case_id and assign rank modulo 5; bootstrap multiplicities retain the formal case fold.
lambda_selection: highest pooled OOF equal-domain macro accuracy
temperature_selection: lowest selected-lambda pooled OOF equal-domain NLL

routing_and_fusion.hard: argmax softmax(router_logits/T), exact tie lowest domain index
routing_and_fusion.probability_constraints: finite, nonnegative, each row sums to one, no null/zero row
routing_and_fusion.soft: p_mix=sum_d alpha_d*p_expert_d; probability averaging only, never logit averaging

V0_1_control_reproduction.evidence_rule: Recompute descriptors and validation expert probabilities under V0.2; do not reuse V0.1 rows as V0.2 evidence.
